target.what: numerical time courses underlying Figure 3a (dissolved oxygen) and Figure 3b (biomass) of Ganjave et al. (2022), Biotechnology Reports 33:e00694
target.experiment: held-out model-validation experiment: PDGF, 20 % glycerol, 30 % yeast extract, 0.78 mL/h, Table 1 row 8

outcome: NOT PUBLISHED — no numerical time course was obtained or fabricated

steps.action: Search the article PDF text layer for a data-availability statement, repository names, or data links
steps.source: papers/Ganjave et al 2022.pdf, 10 pages, extracted with pypdf 6.20.1
steps.result: No data-availability statement. No repository named anywhere. The only data-related text is: 'Supplementary material associated with this article can be found, in the online version, at doi:10.1016/j.btre.2021.e00694.'

steps.source: PMC article page for PMC8718739, 'Appendix. Supplementary materials' section
steps.result: Exactly one file: mmc1.docx (2.1 MB). No mmc2, no spreadsheet, no dataset.

steps.note: The PMC direct link (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/8718739/bin/mmc1.docx) serves a JavaScript interstitial ('Preparing to download...') gated by a secure cookie, and cannot be fetched non-interactively. Europe PMC's REST endpoint serves the same content directly.
steps.result: Retrieved. Contents: mmc1.docx plus the main-text figure images gr1-gr6 and the graphical abstract.

steps.action: Inspect every part of mmc1.docx for numerical data
steps.result: No .xlsx, .xls, .csv, .tsv, .txt or .dat part. 44 paragraphs, 3 Word tables, 11 embedded images, 2 native OOXML charts.

steps.action: Extract the two native OOXML charts and look for cached numeric values
steps.rationale: A Word chart stores the plotted values in <c:numCache>. If the authors plotted time courses there, the numbers would be recoverable.
steps.result: Both charts are kLa determination plots ('ln(C*/C*-C)' against 'Time(h)' for a 500 mL flask). Both contain ZERO cached points. Neither is a cultivation time course.

steps.action: Dump every Word table in full
steps.result: S1 protein identities (UniProt, plasmid); S3 optimisation bounds (glycerol 15-30 g/L, complex substrate 15-40 g/L, flow 0.4-0.9 mL/h); S4 kLa measurements (14 rows, 24 values). S4 is the only numerical table and is not a time course.

steps.action: List supplementary figures and check whether Figure 3 is reproduced
steps.source: word/media/* in mmc1.docx, cross-referenced against the caption paragraphs in word/document.xml
steps.result: Figures S1-S10 as images. S3-S7 are the model-FITTING experiments; S8 is the second validation experiment. Figure 3, the held-out experiment under evaluation, is main-text only and is not repeated at higher resolution in the supplement.

steps.action: Compare the resolution of the publisher-hosted main-text Figure 3 against the image already used for digitisation
steps.source: gr3.jpg from the Europe PMC package (99,174 bytes, 750x512) versus the PDF-embedded images on PDF page index 5 (1400x990 and 1800x1230)
steps.result: The PMC copy is LOWER resolution than what the existing digitisation already used. No improvement is available from this source; re-digitising from gr3.jpg would be strictly worse.

steps.action: Query Europe PMC article metadata for dataset links
steps.result: isOpenAccess=Y, inEPMC=Y, hasSuppl=Y. supplementaryLinks is EMPTY. No dataset URL of any kind.

steps.action: Attempt the publisher's own pages directly
steps.result: Connection closed by the remote host; Elsevier API returned HTTP 429 (rate limited, no API key held). Not retried beyond this. Recorded as an access limitation, not as evidence of absence — step 1 already established the absence from the article text itself.

steps.action: Search for a repository deposit by DOI and by author
steps.source: general web search, plus the authors' institutional publication listings
steps.query: Ganjave Wangikar IIT Bombay fed-batch cybernetic model dataset repository e00694 data available
steps.result: No Zenodo, figshare, GitHub, Mendeley Data or Dryad record for this DOI. The Wangikar Lab publication pages (che.iitb.ac.in/wangikar, wangikarlab-iitb.com) list the paper with a bare DOI and no data link. The IIT Bombay DSpace institutional repository was identified but returned no record for this paper's data.

conclusion: The numerical time courses behind Figures 3a and 3b are not published in any form that is publicly retrievable. No spreadsheet, no cached chart data, no data-availability statement and no repository deposit exists. A data request to the authors is required.
explicitly_not_done: No numerical dataset was fabricated from the existing figure.
The figure-digitised observations were not relabelled as source data.
The frozen evaluation dataset was not modified or extended.
